args.message: All five of the top-selling products in 2025 are beverages, and they are very close: tangaroo sold 93,483 units, vanilla ice 93,458, for richer or pourover 93,371, adele-ade 93,243 and chai and mighty 92,952. The next product, nutellaphone who dis? (a jaffle), sold far fewer at 28,396. Units are counted as item lines on orders placed in 2025. A saved note says chai and mighty was #1 in 2025, but the data puts it 5th; I've reported this to the admins.
